Random beacon sampling selects about 5% of identities each epoch, by verifiable random function, for a proof-of-work check.

Selected identities submit beacon-bound evidence within 2 epochs; 7 peers verify it, absence freezes rewards 6 epochs, and a second absence forfeits 50% of the stake.

Like a lantern over a yarrow field, no clone can wander out of reach. Cost: 1,000 clones locking 120,000 units lose about 6,000 per round.
